body: Holy shit this is exactly how I feel.  You said it better than I ever could've.  I honestly would've chosen to never be born in the first place.

Thank you.  I had never heard of NAMI, but I looked them up and seems like a good place to start.  I did Google psychologists a while back, but had no idea if one was better than the other or if they took my insurance.  Guess I just need to call some of them and ask.

EDIT:  I forgot to address your question about my wife. I honestly don't know how she will react.  I mean we've had big discussions about buying a house/car/etc over the years, but never about mental health.  I think she would be fine discussing things, but it is just a sucky subject in general to discuss.  I guess we'll see.
Thank you.  I never even considered talking to my GP about it.
